packagemanager/pypi.go: 2

`610-610`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Recognize the remaining supported archive formats.** For `pip install --no-deps example-1.0.tar.xz`, the new boolean registration preserves the filename, but this list does not reject it. Pip 26.3 supports `.tar.xz`, `.tgz`, `.tar`, and additional archive extensions. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pypa/pip/26.3/src/pip/_internal/utils/filetypes.py)) The parser now attempts a registry lookup for the filename and returns a resolution error if that name is absent. Previously, the unknown flag consumed this argument. Add the supported archive extensions and regression cases. Keep registry requirements accepted. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spf13/pflag/v1.0.10/flag.go))

Review comment at @packagemanager/pypi.go at line 610: Extend the archive-extension list in the package filename parsing path to recognize pip-supported formats such as .tar.xz, .tgz, and .tar, and add regression cases for those filenames. Preserve acceptance of registry requirements. ```
--- `611-611`: ** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Remove extras before checking the archive suffix.** For `pip install --no-deps 'requests-2.31.0-py3-none-any.whl[security]'`, this check sees `]`, not `.whl`. Pip accepts archive extras and removes them before classifying the archive. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pypa/pip/26.3/src/pip/_internal/req/constructors.py)) The new registration retains this argument. The downstream parser removes the extras, then resolves the wheel filename as a registry package. That produces a resolution error when the filename is absent from the registry. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/safedep/pmg/61f4d24cb745fc83adcaf0ee7d74fcc44941c07c/packagemanager/pypi_resolver.go)) Use an extras-free temporary string for classification. Keep `requests[security]==2.31.0` accepted.
